process.headline: The Madame Wedding Design process
process.lead: What will happen, in the order it will happen — so every step feels inevitable, never a surprise.

phases.title: Listening.
phases.body: We learn who you are, what this wedding should tell, and set the scope budget.

phases.title: Design.
phases.body: The global creative direction, then a board for each moment — from welcome to farewell.

phases.title: Production.
phases.body: Vendor curation, contracts, stationery, logistics. You approve, the house orchestrates.

phases.title: The wedding days.
phases.body: The house is on site, from the first arrival to the last departure.
